payload.name: Preserve preference purpose across extraction and updates
payload.description: Use when creating or updating a memory for a user's stated preference/plan that includes an explicit purpose ('so that', 'to', 'because', 'in order to'); preserve both preference and purpose and avoid overwriting it with unrelated updates.
content: When a statement contains a preference and an explicit purpose clause, extract the preference and the purpose as one memory object; do not emit a candidate that only repeats the surface preference.

During CRUD, before rewriting an existing memory that captures a durable preference, check whether the incoming message is about a different topic; if it is, ADD a new memory instead of UPDATE or MERGE, so the original preference and its purpose remain available.
Only preserve purposes that are explicit in the message; a time or place modifier alone is not a purpose, so do not fabricate one.

solves: When a stated preference is recorded without its explicit reason, or later overwritten by an unrelated update, motivation questions cannot be answered. Apply when a user statement pairs a preference/plan with an explicit purpose ('so that', 'to', 'because') and when updating an older preference memory with unrelated new information. Do not apply when no purpose is stated, and never invent a reason absent from the evidence.
